q: Can you describe a challenging situation you faced and how you handled it?
a:
One challenging situation I faced was starting a new project without knowing whether it would pay off or not. There was no clear roadmap, and I had limited resources and time.

At first, it was difficult because there was a lot of uncertainty. Instead of feeling overwhelmed, I decided to focus on small, manageable steps. I looked into the problem, planned my tasks carefully, and worked consistently every day.

Over time, I started to see progress. This experience taught me how to stay patient, adapt to uncertainty, and keep moving forward despite the challenges.
